description: Renders a single comment within a thread: author avatar initials, name, timestamp (with an edited indicator), body text, mention chips, a reaction bar, and edit/delete actions gated by the current user's permissions.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Current user id for permissions and active reaction styling.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when editing is requested.

parameters.name: OnEditRequested
parameters.description: Callback invoked when picker open state changes.

parameters.name: OnReactionToggled
parameters.description: Callback invoked when deleting is requested.

parameters.name: PickerOpenChanged
parameters.description: Whether this comment's reaction picker is open.
